'''February 2000 Montreal tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Montreal, Quebec on 20 February 2000. [[Yannick Lapointe]] won it. It is known from Yannick Lapointe's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d275">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-21-montreal-quebec-02-20-2000d275/ montreal-quebec-02-20-2000], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 21 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-21-montreal-quebec-02-20-2000d275/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 February 2000
* '''Site:''' Montreal, Quebec
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 15
* '''Winner:''' [[Yannick Lapointe]]
